You can export your ChatGPT conversations `using OpenAI's built-in data export tool, browser extensions, or manual methods`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF15KRwEsYPT7Z_P4GqI7YGrTC53i7xKd32aRpopY5Hlhb1e0vGYI4y3gLmPNYHLuMeSjk39LIFcvCx69p75l8d6-eqXiuKs0QodHYQyU6TJ-_ULIhMMDZaa5hhTIVRbgV1a6U9SLXeQyVrQ9aoUlpbPEu5U20ET9M8xWiULCvP9CpFgc6oZ5uT978sXCb4i7cNCR9FryDob3WuHcj1Ux1oVrFrjaL0Z339QiYA2CYa2yiNRgTocmG2IgtD_88K-5jpGc737NupS3Y3rD8jQ41s50)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)

### Method 1: Export All Chat History (Official Way)

OpenAI lets you download your entire chat history as a ZIP file containing JSON and HTML files.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1wOhj2cebrSqMKHrfC4eJPqyiQ9iM_bN9rhjbc-YvnL6rSNufRzkaSPgK27KAZB-eobHY5MMd8TJtR3q8PdTPXd2H7Zvq-_QeLIZhL0P3GzhicoFOXwSHKsF-xdCWK-SIC5CXZp2Fd9f77y2qZFo-K9IzyImwsd1bxQMICcJ1_caz0niYfd1ma8_S_4)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nque60rkbe8)

1. Log in to [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXXSArG8X-RkNIX4ajewrwnoPGMAOo6_SX-wBaZtWooG-vSQCr1JuEoNX4VvTE2H5LoLnn3SNu1zNyUUw43s8s-JX0vQvK27YdhcPq9).
2. Click your **profile icon** in the bottom-left corner.
3. Select **Settings** > **Data controls**.
4. Click **Export** or **Export data** , then confirm the request.
5. Complete any verification prompts (such as a code sent via email or SMS).
6. Wait for an email from OpenAI (this can take anywhere from a few minutes up to 7 days).
7. Click **Download data export** in the email. *Note: The link expires after 24 hours.* 
8. Unzip the downloaded file to view your data, which includes a readable `chat.html` file or raw JSON files.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3QbxZr7J4L4)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E08P_Of2Ui8&t=4)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF1wOhj2cebrSqMKHrfC4eJPqyiQ9iM_bN9rhjbc-YvnL6rSNufRzkaSPgK27KAZB-eobHY5MMd8TJtR3q8PdTPXd2H7Zvq-_QeLIZhL0P3GzhicoFOXwSHKsF-xdCWK-SIC5CXZp2Fd9f77y2qZFo-K9IzyImwsd1bxQMICcJ1_caz0niYfd1ma8_S_4)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nque60rkbe8)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXRdrYIgcWQCd2XOnSFL1geg1m919NkUdqyJWYOsNxtMgGwP0D_2ZMFB8BOu_NDbj7dCfiPkejm4_gxpud-UVGLZz-ctiUjASBdNHdn8MPWOVQO7ajkYDX-9yw_GCxWcP6Ya-ZTLF71uPnmFMT)[[7]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/esX4PAb2rbc)

### Method 2: Export a Single Conversation
If you only need to save or share one specific chat thread:

- **Share a read-only link:** Open the conversation, click the **Share** icon at the top right, and choose **Copy link**.
- **Save as PDF via browser:** Open the conversation, press `Ctrl + P` (Windows) or `Command + P` (Mac), and select **Save as PDF** as your destination.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF15csvlretxNGFzi1QOW5Dpw9zoBOQpwKqplEB28AeUnZb2bOWvWEJB2pdsnhGMeu7NNmHH6ik1Acvas_apo2TXJKJtXeeAjSKfgjT9nWeex4-wZkvE-gGiAe96AckciIlGkPipQcoDeSGO--KFZhyVQToNDhlrkGC9VyyPvIZWOIz4N9UkzBwhyBg0uUjD-jNSCpD32g)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jeS1JSln5T8&t=1)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E08P_Of2Ui8&t=4)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

### Method 3: Use Browser Extensions or Scripts
Opinions are mixed on manual methods for large threads, as users on the [OpenAI Community Forum](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF15KRwEsYPT7Z_P4GqI7YGrTC53i7xKd32aRpopY5Hlhb1e0vGYI4y3gLmPNYHLuMeSjk39LIFcvCx69p75l8d6-eqXiuKs0QodHYQyU6TJ-_ULIhMMDZaa5hhTIVRbgV1a6U9SLXeQyVrQ9aoUlpbPEu5U20ET9M8xWiULCvP9CpFgc6oZ5uT978sXCb4i7cNCR9FryDob3WuHcj1Ux1oVrFrjaL0Z339QiYA2CYa2yiNRgTocmG2IgtD_88K-5jpGc737NupS3Y3rD8jQ41s50) note that lengthy threads can become cumbersome to manage. Many users prefer third-party options for more readable formats like Markdown, Word, Notion, or PDF:[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES1QEBxCJF15KRwEsYPT7Z_P4GqI7YGrTC53i7xKd32aRpopY5Hlhb1e0vGYI4y3gLmPNYHLuMeSjk39LIFcvCx69p75l8d6-eqXiuKs0QodHYQyU6TJ-_ULIhMMDZaa5hhTIVRbgV1a6U9SLXeQyVrQ9aoUlpbPEu5U20ET9M8xWiULCvP9CpFgc6oZ5uT978sXCb4i7cNCR9FryDob3WuHcj1Ux1oVrFrjaL0Z339QiYA2CYa2yiNRgTocmG2IgtD_88K-5jpGc737NupS3Y3rD8jQ41s50)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rCVXWIthDc&vl=en-US&t=9)

- **Chrome Extensions:** Tools like [ExportGPT: Export ChatGPT Conversation](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn) let you one-click export active chats into PDF, Markdown, HTML, or Excel.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)
- **Open Source Scripts:** Developers can use command-line tools or console scripts like the [ChatGPT Conversation Exporter](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXuH2pR2q5dEyX5weLirdNywTcv-pJ6yRj-5hu70uW-9vgELNq5NtkjxOCtC5yKYtLQpKDiqNtaCT_EsSVLKLrkWgIFkQrGvkxX6azp84gH683baUueUKsjBNqSoNSZwWZ7dHX_oM40dpk_a4p4SlV1x9i5n4mtPs) to pull full histories directly into local Markdown and JSON files.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXuH2pR2q5dEyX5weLirdNywTcv-pJ6yRj-5hu70uW-9vgELNq5NtkjxOCtC5yKYtLQpKDiqNtaCT_EsSVLKLrkWgIFkQrGvkxX6azp84gH683baUueUKsjBNqSoNSZwWZ7dHX_oM40dpk_a4p4SlV1x9i5n4mtPs)
